ONE KNOB: lr 0.005->0.001 (5x DOWN) -- the GENUINELY-UNTRIED scalar. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, hr=metric of record): (1) iter-1 hr 0.027984 ep8; iter-2 hr 0.028237 ep24 = BEST; iter-3 hr 0.0 img_n_bf=6 (image capacity DESTABILIZED); iter-4 hr 0.028237 proj_n_bf=2 (FLAT); iter-5 hr 0.009801 train_n=480/ep12 (DATA-COVERAGE REGRESSED -- 12-param bilateral too small to exploit data, like wu/hammernik_vn). (2) LIMITER: every MAPPED knob is spent -- epochs INERT, image-capacity HURTS, proj-capacity FLAT, data-coverage REGRESSED. BUT the base lr=0.005 (Wagner BF default) has NEVER been moved on this run, and the campaign caveat this tick is that two solvers (itnet k=1, wu lr-DOWN) just BROKE assumed ceilings via a single genuinely-untried knob. lr is the untouched axis. (3) ONE KNOB = lr 0.005->0.001. JUSTIFICATION vs proj_sr (the other untried candidate, campaign-noted as the Mayo bilateral over-smoothing lever): proj_sr is an INIT the supervised MSE already trains via gradient descent, so moving it is a within-trainable-DOF re-seed; lr instead changes HOW the MSE settles those 12 sigmas. The epochs-inert result (ep8->24 flat) means the sigmas at lr=0.005 converge to a FLAT/over-smoothed basin fast -- a finer lr is the classic wu-style falsifier (wu cleared its ceiling at 10x-lower lr). lr is the cleaner falsification of the structural-ceiling claim. (4) HYPOTHESIS: lr 0.005->0.001 lifts hr above 0.028237 because the 12 BF sigmas at lr=0.005/ep24 are stuck in a flat over-smoothed basin (epochs inert = converged-but-suboptimal); a 5x finer rate lets the RMSE-sensitive MSE settle them at a SHARPER (less-smoothing) optimum, mirroring wu lr-DOWN breaking its ceiling. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if hr stays <=0.030 (flat) OR regresses at lr=0.001, the lr axis is exhausted too -> FILE THE STRUCTURAL-CEILING VERDICT: hr~0.028 is the 12-param-bilateral structural ceiling on real 2304-view Mayo LDCT, robust across epochs, both-domain capacity, data-coverage, AND learning rate -- no within-architecture scalar escapes it. (5) BUDGET: HARD 1200s train+score. lr change is ZERO extra compute. iter-2 (ep24/tn200/12p) ran 449.6s -> this run ~450s, comfortably <1200s (30-min sbatch wall). epochs=24 KEPT, train_n=200 KEPT (iter-2 base), img_n_bf=3 KEPT, proj_n_bf=1 KEPT, all sigmas/kernels/lambda_neg/seed identical to iter-2, val_n=214 KEPT, grad_clip=1.0 KEPT. (6) Loop continues -- no control returned.
